summary: Tested new Auth & Onboarding layer end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 9/9 pytest passing for /api/v1/auth (demo, login, signup, me + 400/401 error cases). Frontend: all 5 request scenarios verified - default-authenticated access to 6 protected routes on fresh contexts works, login screen UI + validation (invalid email + short password inline error) works, Continue as Grace / Google / Apple all navigate to /dashboard, Forgot Password modal (open, submit, success, done-close) works, Sign In/Sign Up toggle works with Forgot link correctly hidden on /signup, Logout redirects to /login and same-session SPA nav to /dashboard correctly bounces back to /login. Regression smoke on Dashboard/Activity/Profile/Podcast + Achievements modal (Mindful Master & Mindful Streak both present) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor UX: form uses <input type='email'> which triggers native HTML5 validation before the JS validate() runs, so users typing e.g. 'bademail' get a native browser tooltip instead of the styled inline auth-error-message. Works fine functionally (URL stays on /login), but the custom error message never appears for the invalid-format case. Consider adding noValidate on the <form> so the styled inline error is always shown.
AuthService.signup silently ignores duplicate/new emails and always returns Grace - acceptable per the explicit 'simplified demo' user choice, but worth a comment in code to prevent future confusion.

AuthContext useEffect auto-fetches /auth/demo on mount when session is null and loggedOut is false - the intentional 'auto login as Grace on hard reload' behavior. Documented in the request; no action needed.
test_credentials: Any valid-format email + 6+ char password logs in as Grace (per explicit demo scope). Demo button (no creds) also works. /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not required since demo endpoints accept anything.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded DB post-test via `cd /app/server && npx ts-node src/seed.ts` - Grace + 7-day activity + meals + podcasts + leaderboard + reminders restored to pristine state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is a client-side gate only (ProtectedRoute in App.tsx); API endpoints are open. Default-logged-in behavior means fresh browser contexts land on /dashboard directly without visiting /login - this is intentional. To test true logout enforcement, use SPA navigation (history.pushState + popstate) since page.goto() triggers a full reload which auto-re-authenticates by design.
